answer: Because the timing is recorded against the ridge challenge, the saffron audit can replay the signal history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 135 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. That bill is paid per identity, so 113 aliases cost 188 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
